title: Titanium Chlorine Compressor Impeller
alloyReason: Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni (UNS R53400) is selected for this reactor hardware chemical processing application where HCl/H2SO4 resistance up to 200C is required beyond CP grades. Mo+Ni stabilize the passive film in crevice conditions. This rationale is driven by wet chlorine gas compressor impeller and service environment demands.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for reactor hardware geometry
CNC corrosion allowance with Class 6g gauge
TIG welding Grade 2 with Class 6g gauge
Hydrostatic shell test with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming
commonFailures: Galvanic acceleration at Ti-steel weld joint - controlled by PTFE insulating gasket + CP adjustment

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Chlorine Compressor Impeller suitable for Wet chlorine gas compressor impeller?
faq.a: Titanium Chlorine Compressor Impeller uses Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address reactor hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Chlorine Compressor Impeller?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Chlorine Compressor Impeller require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. reactor hardware components receive Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Chlorine Compressor Impeller shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Compressor impeller / Cl2 impeller reactor hardware components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
